name: Nonfeed Live Validator Strictness
description: Harden f234_validate_nonfeed_live_report.py with 4 new exit rules for bad live report patterns

exit_codes.1: MALFORMED — truth missing or structural failure
exit_codes.3: KPI FAILED — runtime_accepted vs branch counts mismatch
exit_codes.5: SOURCE FAMILY INCONSISTENCY — terminal stage present without outcome entry
exit_codes.6: DUPLICATE SOURCE FAMILIES — CT+ct or PUBLIC+public coexistence (NEW)
exit_codes.7: PROFILE/PRIORITY MISMATCH — CT-expected run with profile=default or np_enabled=False (NEW)
exit_codes.8: CT PRELUDE CONTRADICTION — CT missing from prelude but ct_attempted_error present without flag (NEW)
exit_codes.9: PUBLIC DISCOVERY_ERROR MISSING REASON — DISCOVERY_ERROR without reason or provider_errors (NEW)

new_checks.name: _check_duplicate_normalized_source_families
new_checks.description: Detects CT/ct or PUBLIC/public coexistence after lowercase normalization

new_checks.name: _check_profile_priority_mismatch
new_checks.description: Detects acquisition_profile=default or nonfeed_priority_enabled=False when CT was expected

new_checks.name: _check_ct_prelude_contradiction
new_checks.description: Detects CT in missing_lanes + ct_attempted_error + missing/inconsistent ct_prelude_missing_but_final_attempted flag

new_checks.name: _check_public_discovery_error_missing_reason
new_checks.description: Detects public DISCOVERY_ERROR without public_discovery_empty_reason or provider_errors

assertions.1: Report with CT and ct fails exit 6 — VERIFIED
assertions.2: Report with PUBLIC and public fails exit 6 — VERIFIED
assertions.3: acquisition_profile=default when expected=nonfeed_diagnostic fails exit 7 — VERIFIED
assertions.4: nonfeed_priority_enabled=false when expected=nonfeed_diagnostic fails exit 7 — VERIFIED
assertions.5: CT in missing_lanes + ct_attempted_error + ct_prelude_missing_but_final_attempted=False fails exit 8 — VERIFIED
assertions.6: public DISCOVERY_ERROR with no reason/provider_errors fails exit 9 — VERIFIED
assertions.8: Exit priority: fallback(4) > duplicate(6) > profile_mismatch(7) > CT_contradiction(8) > public_reason(9) — VERIFIED
assertions.10: No runtime imports with side effects — VERIFIED

failed_checks: profile_priority_mismatch: acquisition_profile=default (should be nonfeed_diagnostic for CT-expected run); nonfeed_priority_enabled=False (should be True for CT-expected run)
public_discovery_error_reason: public_terminal_stage=DISCOVERY_ERROR but no public_discovery_empty_reason and no provider_errors surface
nonfeed_priority: nonfeed_priority_enabled=None, expected True or skip reason
